SAFETY CENTRE

Stay safe when trading

✅ Meet in a busy public place and inspect the item carefully.
⛔ Never pay a deposit before seeing the item or property.
🔐 Never share OTP codes, PINs, passwords or bank login details.
🧾 For expensive items, request proof of ownership and a receipt.
🚨 If something feels suspicious, use “Report scam” on the ad.

HELP CENTRE

Quick help

How do I post an ad?

Tap “Post an ad”, add details and up to five clear photos, then publish.

Is LAKDEALZ free?

Yes. The launch period currently allows free ad posting.

How do I stay safe?

Inspect first, meet publicly, verify ownership and never pay in advance.

How do reports work?

Use Report on any ad. Your report is recorded for admin review.
